participation.context: Said no play, and added nothing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the dozen words, and kept today on.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Took the bill down, and refused a cause.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

story.body: You agreed the bill comes down, and you left the cause unwritten.

participation.context: Wrote the two words and closed the book.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put two words in the square and left the rest of it blank.

title: Wrote No play in Thursday's square
